bodySerialNumberE4.description: The camera body serial number in EXIF BodySerialNumber and in XMP exifEX:BodySerialNumber. Device identity: it identifies one physical camera.
bodySerialNumberE4.label: Camera body serial number (EXIF and XMP)

exposureBiasE4.description: Exposure compensation in EV steps as the exact stored signed numerator and denominator pair (EXIF ExposureBiasValue and XMP exif:ExposureBiasValue), so -1/3 and -2/6 differ.
exposureBiasE4.label: Exposure compensation (exact signed fraction, EXIF and XMP)

exposureTimeE4.description: Exposure time in seconds as the exact stored numerator and denominator pair (EXIF ExposureTime and XMP exif:ExposureTime), so 10/30 and 1/3 stay different values.
exposureTimeE4.label: Exposure time (exact fraction, EXIF and XMP)

fNumberE4.description: The F-number as the exact stored numerator and denominator pair (EXIF FNumber and XMP exif:FNumber), so a transfer reproduces the pair, not only its value.
fNumberE4.label: Aperture F-number (exact fraction, EXIF and XMP)

focalLength35mmE4.description: The 35 mm equivalent focal length as a whole number of millimetres (EXIF FocalLengthIn35mmFormat and XMP exif:FocalLengthIn35mmFilm). It is the recorded value, not a computed one.
focalLength35mmE4.label: Focal length in 35 mm film terms (EXIF and XMP)

focalLengthE4.description: The focal length in millimetres as the exact stored numerator and denominator pair (EXIF FocalLength and XMP exif:FocalLength).
focalLengthE4.label: Focal length (exact fraction, EXIF and XMP)

isoSpeedE4.description: The ISO speed rating as a whole number (EXIF ISO, tag 0x8827, and XMP exifEX:PhotographicSensitivity), so a sidecar can carry and supply it.
isoSpeedE4.label: ISO speed (EXIF and XMP)

lensMakeE4.description: The lens manufacturer text in EXIF LensMake and in XMP exifEX:LensMake, so a sidecar can carry and supply it. Device identity.
lensMakeE4.label: Lens make (EXIF and XMP)

lensModelE4.description: The lens model text in EXIF LensModel and in XMP exifEX:LensModel, so a sidecar can carry and supply it. Device identity.
lensModelE4.label: Lens model (EXIF and XMP)

lensSerialNumberE4.description: The lens serial number in EXIF LensSerialNumber and in XMP exifEX:LensSerialNumber. Device identity: it identifies one physical lens.
lensSerialNumberE4.label: Lens serial number (EXIF and XMP)
